name: Prohall Absolut One Spray Mask
headline: Meet Absolut One — the 12-in-1 spray mask
title: Meet Absolut One | Prohall 12-in-1 Spray Mask 200 ml
meta: Prohall Absolut One Spray Mask 200 ml / 6.76 fl oz: a 12-in-1 leave-in conditioning spray with heat and UV protection, made with lactic acid and panthenol.
lede: A multifunctional 12-in-1 conditioning spray with sun protection. Use it as a leave-in treatment, a finishing spray and a split-end conditioner — on damp or dry hair.

Reduces frizz and excess volume for smoother hair.
Works as a split-end conditioner to help prevent split ends.
Helps protect hair from heat styling.
Acts as a protective barrier against UVA/UVB radiation.
Helps protect color from pollution and environmental stress.

steps.title: Your Absolut One routine
steps.intro: One spray, three ways to use it. Apply to damp or dry hair and style as desired.
items: Spray through towel-dried hair as a leave-in treatment.
Mist over dry hair as a finishing spray, or on the ends as a split-end conditioner.
Style as desired: blow dry, flat iron or let it air dry.
steps.note: Good to know: one 200 ml bottle provides about 2 months of treatment for medium to long hair. Always read and follow the directions on the product label.
